purpose: Test whether the residual c2 required after the documented Magnicon XXF-1 10 kHz Bessel LPF is repeatable across the 2024-12-05 repeat and 2024-12-06 reference acquisitions.
guardrail: This is adjacent-day same-condition repeatability, not independent operating-point validation. Repeatable c2 or its magnitude-equivalent first-order zero supports a stable readout-shape candidate, but cannot by itself distinguish readout electronics from a detector-model deficiency that repeats under the same operating condition. The XXF-1 LPF state during the 2024-12-05/06 acquisition remains unverified. No production data or production noise model are modified.
